## Film Runtime and IMDb Ratings

This page look at if longer films tend to receive different IMDb ratings compared to shorter films. @fig-runtime-rating shows the relationship between the two variables of film runtime and IMDb rating.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Film runtime and IMDb ratings"
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])

plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")

plt.show()
```

## Average IMDb Rating by Decade

The following table summarizes the mean IMDb rating by decade.

```{python}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10

films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
